what: Three logo pieces, scattered and spinning (first piece −130.6° etc.), fill up in turn from the center outward, up and down, according to loading progress — pieces not yet filled remain as .055 transparent shadows floating with sin(.75t + 1.7×index) × 1.2, and stretch vertically from .7 → 1x as they fill. Once full, choice buttons such as QUIET · SOUND rise from 115% below over .44s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1) staggered by .06 (if gather is given, the pieces first gather into place to form the logo). Pressing one lowers the buttons and (if the pieces have not gathered yet, after they gather in .8s) after lag, during fly the logo shrinks around one point to fit the header logo slot (to) box, stays for stay, then the panel disappears over out seconds and fires fx:enter(detail.choice)

options.to: Header-line logo css that the logo flies to and overlaps (if absent, it vanishes in place)
options.min: Minimum seconds until fully filled, default 1.4
options.fill · hold: If fill is set, the fill-up is spread evenly over that many seconds (not exceeding the ready share), hold is the rest in seconds after fully filled before the button rises, default 0 · 0
options.fly · lag: Length the logo shrinks into the header row position · delay after picking (seconds), default .9 · .7 — it only shrinks around the one point that reaches its place without moving (with the same curve, the length equals shrinking while moving)
options.show: Seconds of rest after the first drawing is painted until the logo appears and starts filling, default 0 — time counts from the first frame, not from document ready (original first page measured: appears after .45s, fills in .85s, rests .67s, then gathers into a button in .5s — show .45 · fill .85 · hold .67 · gather .5)
options.gather · stay: gather: seconds spent gathering the pieces after it fills and rests for hold, before the button rises (0 means they gather .8s after the pick, default 0) · stay: seconds the flown logo stays at the header-bar spot (default 0)
options.out · fly-ease: out: seconds for the panel to disappear, if 0 the panel is removed outright (display) and the logo size is restored to its initial value (default .3) · fly-ease: the curve of the flight (default 0.65,0,0.25,1) — the original first-page measurement (.93s sine.inOut after .17s, entrance door dismantled at 2.6s) is lag .04 · fly .95 · fly-ease 0.45,0,0.55,1 · stay 1.45 · out 0

parts.mark: <svg> — Inside each piece <g data-piece> (There don’t have to be three pieces)
parts.choices: Choice button group — data-choice on each button, one at a time <span> Wrapped in it, they rise from inside. Without it, they gather and fly away as soon as they fill up

events.fx:ready: Sent — when it fills up and the button rises
events.fx:enter: Submit — detail.choice when the logo lands in place after choosing
events.fx:choose: Dispatch — the instant the button is pressed detail.choice (when starting the next scene’s entrance together with the flight)

note: The plate colors are --fx-gate-bg and --fx-gate-ink (default --kf-bg and --kf-ink). The original fills the pieces to the height of a clipPath rectangle (84 × filled share), and hovering over the sound button makes the pieces shake more (left out here). The original logo shape is not used. Both the demo and the site use our three pieces (ring, pillar, hook).
